title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Pantry Staples Guide
summary: Start pantry staples guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Audit what you actually cook
2. List your 30-40 staples
3. Buy spices whole where possible
4. Decant into clear labeled containers
5. Organize by category

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
